tagline: Cook it, understand it, and know where to eat it.

items.name: Pailin's Kitchen (formerly Hot Thai Kitchen)
items.why: Le Cordon Bleu-trained Thai chef. Explains the how and why and the cultural context, not just the recipe.

items.why: Ten years of Thai home-cooking writing (2008–2018). Named best regional cuisine blog by Saveur in 2012.

items.name: Bangkok: Recipes and Stories from the Heart of Thailand
items.why: Leela Punyaratabandhu's book that won the 2018 Art of Eating Prize for best food book of the year.

items.name: Leela Punyaratabandhu on Substack
items.why: Her current writing on Thai food, plus recipes.

items.name: Sabai Talk
items.why: Thai cuisine podcast started in 2024 by Pailin Chongchitnant and chef Hong Thaimee.

briefing.headline: The big talk this week is about coconut milk: Pailin says cartons beat cans for Thai cooking, and fans are mostly surprised cartons exist.

points.text: Pailin's Kitchen says canned coconut milk tastes worse than carton UHT coconut milk. She says she uses Aroy-D and has no affiliation with the brand.
points.label: opinion

points.text: Many commenters say they did not know coconut milk came in cartons. Some say they will look for it next time.
points.label: fan view

points.text: Some commenters say cartons are hard to find where they live, including in the UK and parts of the US.
points.label: fan view

points.text: Hot Thai Kitchen has a Thanksgiving turkey recipe with lemongrass coconut gravy, posted in late October.
points.label: reported
